label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y harás las varas maderas de shitím, y las revestirás oro.
spanish: Y harás las varas de madera de acacia, y las revestirás de oro.
grammarChanges: Supplied the missing construct link between the poles and their material: 'varas de madera' instead of the juxtaposed 'varas maderas'.
Replaced the transliteration 'shitím' with its Spanish common-noun equivalent 'acacia' (H7848 is a common noun, not a proper name).
Supplied the material preposition after the overlay verb: 'revestirás de oro' instead of bare 'revestirás oro'.
